services.name: ASA 101 Basic Keelboat Sailing Course
services.desc: Students MUST complete the two hour Introduction to Sailing Course or get special permission from a Sail Monterey Instructor BEFORE enrolling in this class. Up to 4 Students Duration 3 - 4 Days About Three to four day course designed to train students to proficiently sail on a 30 foot keelboat in light to moderate sea and wind conditions. This class goes over and tests students in the following: Acting as competent skipper and crew Important knots All parts of a sailboat Points of sail Maneuvers: tacking, jibing, heaving to, reefing, man overboard Day 1 and 2 – Practice and lectures Day 3 and 4 - Additional intsrtuction, written test, skills test, and certification

services.name: ASA 103 Basic Coastal Cruising Course
services.desc: Students MUST complete ASA 101 or get special permission from a Sail Monterey Instructor BEFORE enrolling in this class Up to 4 Students Duration 3 Days About Three day course designed to introduce students to the basics of coastal cruising. This class takes place on a 30 ft hunter 30T where you will learn and test on the following: Basic navigation and chart reading Anchoring Parts of a sailboat Sail trim Proper use of an inboard diesel engine AC and DC systems Maneuvers: tacking, jibing, heaving to, reefing, man overboard Day 1 and 2 – Practice and lectures Day 3 - Additional intsrtuction, written test, skills test, and certification

services.name: ASA 104 Bareboat Cruising and Chartering
services.desc: Students MUST complete the 3 day ASA 103 Course or get special permission from a Sail Monterey Instructor BEFORE enrolling in this class Up to 3 Students Duration 3 days & 2 nights About Three day course designed to introduce students to fundamentals of bareboat cruising and chartering. This class takes place on a Hunter 340. This class goes over and tests students in the following: Navigation rules Cruise Planning Reefing Steering a compass course Crew overboard and recovery Electronic Instrumentation and Navigation Anchoring and Mooring Heaving to Docking in unfamiliar places Day 1 – Introduction, lecture, provisioning, & departure for Moss Landing Day 2 – Meal, lecture, sail from Moss
